topline.text: New statutory suspension and exclusion guidance came into force on 26 July 2026 — the framework schools return to in September.
topline.action: Re-read it before term; check your recording and pupil-movement processes line up.

topline.text: KCSIE 2026 safeguarding guidance is confirmed and in force from 1 September.
topline.action: Refresh your child-protection policy and training against the 2026 changes.

diary.text: Statutory suspension & exclusion guidance in force (26 Jul 2026).
KCSIE 2026, Ofsted operating-guide changes and FSM expansion take effect.

items.body: Updated guidance for maintained schools, academies and PRUs — including pupil movement — took effect 26 July 2026.
All schools must publish an inclusion strategy from December 2026 and report on inclusive mainstream funding.
items.action: Your cohort data is the backbone of a credible strategy — see the tool spotlight below.

items.body: In force 1 September: Annex A removed so all staff read Part 1, annual filtering/monitoring review required, plus new provisions on AI, cyber security and misogyny.

box.text: Pupils suspended even once are around twice as likely to be NEET by age 24.
box.attribution: EPI (2024), cited in IPPR & The Difference’s “Who’s Losing Learning?”
